edits.new: kdigo-anemia-2026

edits.match: Hemoglobin (CBC) — G3 at least annually; G4–G5 non-dialysis at least twice yearly
edits.new: **Anemia panel (CBC, reticulocytes, ferritin, TSAT)** — at referral; at least annually G3, at least twice yearly G4, at least every 3 months G5 / G5D; more often on ESA / HIF-PHI, Hb below target, or rapid CKD progression. Anemia = Hb <13.0 g/dL (men), <12.0 g/dL (women). On ESA: Hb every 2–4 weeks after start / dose change (avoid rise >1.0 g/dL per interval), at least every 3 months in maintenance; target Hb <11.5 g/dL (1D), individualized. On HIF-PHI: Hb 2–4 weeks after start / dose change, then every 4 weeks.

edits.match: Iron studies (ferritin, TSAT) — at anemia diagnosis and every 3 months during ESA therapy
edits.new: **Iron studies (ferritin, TSAT)** — with each anemia panel; on iron therapy Hb + ferritin + TSAT every 3 months (non-dialysis / PD) or every 1–3 months (HD); more often after ESA / HIF-PHI start or dose increase, blood loss, or hospitalization. Treat iron deficiency (non-dialysis / PD) if ferritin <100 ng/mL and TSAT <40%, or ferritin 100–<300 ng/mL with TSAT <25%; hold routine iron if ferritin >700 ng/mL or TSAT ≥40%.

edits.match: Screen hemoglobin annually in G3 and twice yearly in G4–G5 non-dialysis (KDIGO 2012 Anemia in CKD)
edits.new: Screen for anemia (CBC, reticulocytes, ferritin, TSAT) at least annually in G3, twice yearly in G4, and every 3 months in G5 (KDIGO 2026 Anemia in CKD)

Cr / eGFR + UACR for G4 (≈3×/yr), G3b A3, G5 (≈4×/yr); Ca / PO4 / PTH for G4 (q3–6 mo) and G5 (q1–3 mo); anemia panel (CBC, retics, ferritin, TSAT) for G5 non-dialysis; Hb + ferritin + TSAT on iron therapy
Cr / eGFR + UACR for G3a A2, G3b A1–A2; anemia panel (CBC, retics, ferritin, TSAT) for G4; Ca / PO4 / PTH for G3a–G3b

Cr / eGFR + UACR for G1–G2 A1–A2 and G3a A1; anemia panel (CBC, retics, ferritin, TSAT) for G3; HbA1c ≥2×/yr if diabetic; vaccination review (influenza, COVID-19, pneumococcal ≥50, RSV ≥75 or 50–74 at risk, HBV)

edits.match: KDIGO 2012 caps ESA-treated Hgb at 11.5 g/dL
edits.new: **Hgb target in CKD anemia.** KDIGO 2026 (final; replaces 2012) keeps ESA-treated Hb <11.5 g/dL (1D) with an individualized target; ESA initiation in non-dialysis CKD is symptom- and risk-based with no fixed Hb trigger; HIF-PHIs are avoided in people at increased risk of adverse events and are never combined with ESAs.

edits.match: USPSTF maintains an "I" statement for asymptomatic-adult CKD screening
edits.new: **USPSTF vs. specialty.** USPSTF's 2012 CKD screening statement is listed as inactive / out of date, with an update in progress. KDIGO and NKF recommend opportunistic case-finding in diabetes, hypertension, age >60, CVD, and family history. The 2025 AHA/ACC BP guideline adds UACR testing for all patients with hypertension.

edits.match: BP target disagreement. KDIGO 2021 / 2024 endorse standardized-office
edits.new: **BP target disagreement.** KDIGO 2021 / 2024 endorse standardized-office SBP <120 mm Hg (Grade 2B). ACC/AHA 2025 (replaces 2017) keeps <130/80 for CKD; KDOQI 2026 commentary supports <130/80 while noting evidence for lower SBP in selected patients; ESC / ESH allows 130–139 systolic; NICE 2019 keeps <140/90. The KDIGO target is contingent on SPRINT-style measurement technique; the lower target is reflected here and the conflict is flagged.

edits.match: Vaccination status (pneumococcal, influenza, hepatitis B, COVID-19)
edits.new: **Vaccination status** (influenza annually; COVID-19 per current CDC season; PCV20 or PCV21 single dose for all ≥50 and younger adults with risk conditions; RSV single dose, not repeated, for all ≥75 and 50–74 at increased risk, e.g., dialysis / ESRD or diabetes with CKD; hepatitis B) — review annually. HBV serology if planning dialysis or transplant.
KDIGO, NKF KDOQI, ACC/AHA, USPSTF (2012 statement inactive; update in progress), CDC, CMS, ASN, NIDDK

edits.match: CHA2DS2-VASc — annually and with any change in clinical status
edits.new: **CHA2DS2-VASc** — annually and with any change in clinical status. Anticoagulate when score ≥2 (men) or ≥3 (women); shared decision for score 1 (men) / 2 (women). Annual documented stroke-risk assessment is a 2026 AHA/ACC AF performance measure.

edits.match: Physical-activity counseling — every visit. Target ~210 min/week
edits.new: **Physical-activity counseling** — every visit. Target ~210 min/week moderate-vigorous activity. Secondary-prevention risk-factor management (weight, activity, smoking, alcohol, BP) is a 2026 AHA/ACC AF performance measure.

edits.match: LAA occlusion (Watchman) candidacy — at any contraindication / major bleed on OAC
edits.new: **LAA occlusion (Watchman) candidacy** — at any OAC contraindication / major bleed; Medicare coverage (NCD 20.34, CED) requires CHADS2 ≥2 or CHA2DS2-VASc ≥3, documented shared decision-making with a non-interventional physician, and inability to take long-term OAC.
gold-2027

edits.match: Exacerbation history (moderate / severe events in past 12 months)
edits.new: **Exacerbation history (moderate / severe events in past 12 months)** — every visit. Defines group E (≥1 moderate or severe exacerbation in the past 12 months). A single moderate exacerbation prompts treatment escalation toward a low-disease-activity state with no exacerbations.

edits.match: Chest CT (low-dose) — as indicated for persistent exacerbations
edits.new: **Chest CT (non-contrast, inspiratory + expiratory)** — at least once in all patients with COPD where available (emphysema, bronchiectasis, mucus plugging, ILA, coronary calcium, bone density; does not replace spirometry); repeat for frequent exacerbations, persistent symptoms despite optimized therapy, LVR evaluation. Annual LDCT lung-cancer screening if ≥20 pack-years, age 50–80 (USPSTF 2021 Grade B).

Non-contrast chest CT at least once after diagnosis (GOLD 2027); repeat for frequent exacerbations / persistent symptoms / suspected lung cancer, emphysema, bronchiectasis; annual LDCT lung-cancer screening if ≥20 pack-years, age 50–80 (USPSTF Grade B); LVR / transplant evaluation

edits.match: ECG / cardiovascular risk assessment — at baseline; reassess after exacerbations
edits.new: **ECG and cardiovascular assessment** — ECG at COPD diagnosis and with unexplained symptom change (Holter if intermittent dizziness / syncope); NT-proBNP / BNP if heart failure suspected, then echo if abnormal; CV risk assessment at baseline and after exacerbations (standard calculators underestimate risk in COPD; CT-derived coronary calcium adds information).
ECG at diagnosis and with unexplained symptom change; NT-proBNP if HF suspected; CV risk reassessment after exacerbations (GOLD 2027)

edits.match: Blood eosinophil count — baseline and when considering ICS
edits.new: **Blood eosinophil count** — baseline and when considering ICS escalation / de-escalation. ≥300 favors ICS (consider LABA+LAMA+ICS as initial therapy in group E) and, with exacerbations despite triple therapy, supports dupilumab (if chronic bronchitis) or mepolizumab (with or without chronic bronchitis) add-on; 100–300 supports ICS if exacerbating; <100 argues against ICS.

edits.match: Vaccinations (annual influenza, updated SARS-CoV-2, PCV20 or PCV21, RSV if ≥60 or comorbid, Tdap, zoster) follow CDC ACIP and should be reviewed yearly
edits.new: Vaccinations (annual influenza; COVID-19 per current CDC season; PCV20 or PCV21 single dose for all ≥50 and younger adults with chronic lung disease; RSV single dose for all ≥75 and 50–74 with COPD; Tdap; zoster) follow CDC and should be reviewed yearly

edits.match: Vaccination status review — annually; aligned to CDC ACIP
edits.new: **Vaccination status review** — annually; aligned to CDC (influenza annually; COVID-19 per current CDC season; PCV20 or PCV21 single dose — all ≥50, 19–49 with chronic lung disease; RSV single dose, not repeated — all ≥75, 50–74 with COPD or other risk condition; Tdap; zoster ≥50).

Spirometry (post-bronchodilator FEV1 / FVC and FEV1 % predicted — at diagnosis + at least annually to detect rapid decliners); vaccination review (influenza annually; COVID-19 per current CDC season; PCV20 or PCV21 single dose ≥50; RSV single dose ≥75 or 50–74 with COPD; Tdap; zoster ≥50)

edits.match: Pulmonary rehabilitation referral — after any exacerbation hospitalization
edits.new: **Pulmonary rehabilitation referral** — after any exacerbation hospitalization (initiate within 3 weeks of discharge); stable patients with mMRC ≥2 / CAT ≥10; GOLD 2027 also advises PR assessment at initial evaluation for groups B and E and for dyspnea at follow-up. CMS NCD 240.8 covers 36 sessions for GOLD II–IV.

edits.match: Annual spirometry. GOLD 2025 advises at least annual spirometry
edits.new: **Annual spirometry.** GOLD 2027 states spirometry "should be repeated at least annually" to detect rapid decline; some primary-care guidance considers it optional in stable, mildly symptomatic patients.

edits.match: GOLD 2025 endorses opportunistic case-finding via spirometry in adults reporting cough, sputum, dyspnea, recurrent LRI, or significant tobacco / biomass exposure
edits.new: GOLD 2026 / 2027 endorses targeted case-finding (questionnaire / risk tool, then spirometry) in adults reporting cough, sputum, dyspnea, recurrent LRI, or significant tobacco / biomass exposure, including people enrolled in lung-cancer screening
L: AAT once, eosinophil count, ABG (SpO2 ≤92%) · I: chest CT once after Dx + red flags / lung-cancer screen · P: ECG at Dx · S: 6MWT, LTOT assessment, PR within 3 wk of exacerbation discharge
acc-hfpef-ecdp-2026

edits.match: Implantable pulmonary artery pressure sensor (CardioMEMS) — continuous monitoring
edits.new: **Implantable pulmonary artery pressure sensor (CardioMEMS / IPAPS)** — daily transmitted pressures with HF-team review. AHA/ACC/HFSA 2022: Class 2b (NYHA III + HF hospitalization in prior 12 mo). Medicare (NCD 20.36, effective 2025-01-13) covers only within a CMS-approved CED study: NYHA II–III, chronic HF ≥3 mo, HF hospitalization / urgent visit within 12 mo OR elevated natriuretic peptide within 30 days, GDMT ≥3 mo, ICD / CRT evaluation ≥3 mo prior, no major CV event within 3 mo. 2026 ACC HFpEF ECDP: consider in selected high-risk HFpEF with persistent symptoms or recurrent hospitalization.

edits.match: CardioMEMS / implantable PA monitoring. Class 2b
edits.new: **CardioMEMS / implantable PA monitoring.** Class 2b "value uncertain" reflects discordant CHAMPION (positive) and GUIDE-HF (neutral) results; specialty HF groups push for broader use. CMS NCD 20.36 (2025) now provides CED coverage for NYHA II–III — wider than the guideline's NYHA III Class 2b (federal vs. society scope difference).

edits.match: BMP (Na, K, Cr, eGFR, BUN, Mg) post-GDMT — within 1–2 weeks
edits.new: **BMP (Na, K, Cr, eGFR, BUN, Mg) post-GDMT** — within 1–2 weeks after starting or titrating ACEi / ARB / ARNI / MRA (steroidal or finerenone) / SGLT2i / diuretic; then every 3–6 months when stable. K 4.0–5.0 mEq/L; tolerate up to ~30% rise in Cr on RAAS initiation; address hyperkalemia >5.5. Finerenone (LVEF ≥40%): label requires K + eGFR before start, at 4 weeks after start and each dose change, then periodically; do not start if K >5.0 or eGFR <25; withhold / reduce for K ≥5.5 per label.

edits.match: SGLT2i in HFpEF. 2022 guideline gave Class 2a
edits.new: **SGLT2i in HFpEF.** 2022 guideline gave Class 2a (EMPEROR-Preserved). The 2026 ACC HFpEF ECDP (replaces 2023) designates SGLT2i plus a nonsteroidal MRA (finerenone; FDA-approved for LVEF ≥40% July 2025) as foundational unless contraindicated, with incretin therapy for BMI ≥30 and SBP target ~120–129 mm Hg. Formal CoR in the 2022 guideline remains 2a; no focused update was issued, and the next full AHA/ACC HF guideline is expected late 2027.

**LVEF categories.** The Second Universal Definition of HF (AHA/ACC/ESC/WHF with HFSA, June 2026) moves away from strict LVEF cutoffs, accounts for LVEF differences by sex, age, and ethnicity, and uses reduced / preserved / improved EF. The 2022 guideline cutoffs (≤40 / 41–49 / ≥50) are retained here pending the 2027 guideline.
